This Self-lock Non-Mementary Metal Pushbutton Switch is a perfect choice if you are in need of a heavy-duty push-button! These metal push buttons are a very tough, small, panel-mount switch with an illuminated Red LED ring. It is an SPDT with 16mm threading and 1mm pitch. It gives a premium look to your dashboard or control panel with an LED light ring around the push area of the switch. These switches are available in various LED light Colours, which you can choose for your application purpose. This switch comes with Non-Momentary Self-Lock action which means it holds its physical position with ON/OFF state until you press it again. A threaded head and a nut, which makes it perfect to be mounted and installed encloses in your project cases showing a flat hexagonal ring structure outside. With glowing, your desired colorful light ring itself in the switch gives an attractive design and premium look that compliments quality panels and dashboards. The switch comes with a Stainless steel body with an IP67 protection rating to provide the best environmental protection and long operational life. This button is perfect for basic On/Off functions. The overall length (including leads) is 26mm and has small solder lugs for connection. These non-momentary Self Lock buttons are rated up to 5A and 12 VDC while the LED is rated for 5V. ON/OFF Function: Push To ON And Push To OFF

SFU1605 Ball Screw Machine Ending With Flange Nut – 400mm

A ball screw is a mechanical linear actuator that translates rotational motion to linear motion with little friction. A threaded shaft provides a helical raceway for ball bearings which act as a precision screw. As well as being able to apply or withstand high thrust loads, they can do so with minimum internal friction. They are made to close tolerances and are therefore suitable for use in situations in which high precision is necessary. The ball assembly acts as the nut while the threaded shaft is the screw. In contrast to conventional lead screws, ball screws tend to be rather bulky, due to the need to have a mechanism to re-circulate the balls bearing.
The structure is simple, easy to install, buffer, damping, convenient to disconnect.
The size is complete and the surface is smooth.
The elastic connection, you can absorb vibration, compensate radial, angular and axial misalignment.
